reviews.comment: The acoustic separation and sub-bass control on these Sennheiser studio cans are phenomenal. Wearing them for 6-hour coding sessions without any clamping fatigue.
USB-C lossless DAC mode makes a night-and-day difference with high-res FLAC tracks. Build quality feels far superior to plastic competitors.
Grade-5 titanium disappears on the wrist. The 80-hour power reserve easily lasts over the weekend and the sapphire crystal has zero glare.
The 3.2K 120Hz OLED screen is breathtaking for Figma and photo grading. Compiles our entire full-stack project in seconds while staying cool.
Shaved 4 minutes off my half-marathon PB in Bengaluru. The carbon plate roll-through feels effortless at tempo pace.
